nodes.label: Supabase Project clgjsekfnexmanjdxmqy
nodes.rationale: Hosts 40 public tables, Auth, RPCs, and 3 Storage buckets (academy-media private, gallery and testimonials public); keeping data on Supabase for the Nov 17 release avoids losing RLS, Auth, Storage, and RPCs compared to migrating to MariaDB.

nodes.label: Repo vs Remote Migration History Mismatch
nodes.rationale: The first 19 files in front/supabase/migrations/ belong to the legacy community project while the 13 Albana files have different timestamps from the 27 remote migrations, so running supabase db push before alignment would attempt to apply legacy community schema.

nodes.label: admin_users Allowlist Table
nodes.rationale: Sole source of truth for admin access (admin or adminsuper) after the legacy members table was dropped.

nodes.label: REGISTRATION_RECEIPT_SECRET
nodes.rationale: Server-only secret used to sign confirmation page tokens; registration endpoints return HTTP 503 if unset.

nodes.label: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY Rotation Requirement
nodes.rationale: The service role key bypasses RLS and was previously stored with a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, creating a full database exposure risk unless rotated before release.
